The '''2019–20 Houston Baptist Huskies men's basketball team''' represented [[Houston Baptist University]] in the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Huskies, led by 29th-year head coach [[Ron Cottrell]], played their home games at [[Sharp Gymnasium]] in [[Houston|Houston, Texas]] as members of the [[Southland Conference]]. They finished the season 4–25, 4–16 in Southland play to finish in last place. They failed to qualify for the [[2020 Southland Conference men's basketball tournament|Southland Conference tournament]].

==Previous season==
The [[2018–19 Houston Baptist Huskies men's basketball team|Huskies]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 12–18 overall, 8–10 in Southland play, to finish in a tie for seventh place. In the [[2019 Southland Conference men's basketball tournament|Southland tournament]], they were defeated by [[2018–19 Lamar Cardinals basketball team|Lamar]] in the first round.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://hbuhuskies.com/news/2019/3/13/mens-basketball-mbb-lamar-sneaks-past-huskies-at-slc-tournament.aspx|title=MBB: Lamar Sneaks Past Huskies at SLC Tournament|work=Houston Baptist University Athletics|access-date=November 26, 2019|language=en}}</ref>
